title: QRY: allowlist.zig hardcodes .kind=.jsonb_key for all entity_filterable_keys rows
symptom: In allowlist.zig:124, all rows loaded from entity_filterable_keys are assigned .kind=.jsonb_key. The design (qry-01-04-entity-query.md) specifies that typed columns from entity_definitions.definition_json.fields (where queried=true) should be merged and have .kind=.typed_column. The missing merge means typed-column entities emit payload ->> $2 SQL against tables without a payload column, causing sqlstate=42703 and HTTP 503.
root_cause: Missing merge of typed-column definitions from entity_definitions.definition_json.fields into the allowlist; all entries default to .kind=.jsonb_key regardless of whether the field maps to a real column.
acceptance_criteria: allowlist.zig reads entity_definitions.definition_json.fields where queried=true and assigns .kind=.typed_column for those fields
All 3 QRY-01 tests pass with no sqlstate=42703 errors
diagnosis: CONFIRMED (Category A). src/entities/query/allowlist.zig loadAllowlist never queries entity_definitions.definition_json.fields. All entity_filterable_keys rows are assigned .kind=.jsonb_key. The typed-column merge step is entirely absent. Additionally tenant_id is silently discarded (_ = tenant_id;) so the SQL filters only by entity_key without tenant scoping. Effect: typed-column entities emit payload ->> dollar-N SQL against tables without a payload column causing sqlstate=42703 and HTTP 503.
